provenance.method: Loaded and answered Select and segment at fp16: one ordinary Load, then two Select and segment requests (warm-up, timed) through Arsenal's API. test night 1 Nov 2026: quiet Mac (idle check before each reading). Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

peakMemoryGB.basis: Load and two Select and segment requests on a 1024×1280 photo.

Quick check, not the controlled interleaved (ABBA) protocol.

secondsPerRequest.basis: One warm Select and segment request on a 1024×1280 photo.
